rationale_evidence.statement: Works Decision 3 (is Pi part of semantic equality) through both branches in full: Branch A (Pi in equiv) makes equiv provenance-discriminating and the finest semantic relation, collapses the provenance-sensitive relation into equiv (redundant), makes D285-5's property VACUOUS, makes a named projection D285-6 illegitimate, produces near-zero deduplication, requires a canonical form carrying Pi (impossible across sources), enables exact replay, and treats the same proposition from two sources as two distinct items rather than a conflict; Branch B (Pi not in equiv) is provenance-blind and coarser, keeps the provenance-sensitive relation distinct, makes D285-5 SUBSTANTIVE, keeps D285-6 legitimate, allows semantic deduplication (losing provenance unless retained separately), risks non-exact replay, and detects conflicts on content. Concludes neither branch is 'the architecture'; both are formally consistent; no recommendation is made.

rationale_evidence.anchor: | *Does any mandatory operation observe `Π`?* | **TECHNICAL** | decidable by the `258-A` congruence experiment ... **`258.31`: *"we do NOT ask philosophically"*.** ⚠️ **Blocked on `𝒪`, not on taste.**
rationale_evidence.statement: Decomposes Decision 3 into what is genuinely normative versus what follows mathematically once normative choices are fixed: whether any mandatory operation actually observes Pi is classified TECHNICAL, decidable via the 258-A congruence experiment (there exists T such that F(H1)=F(H2) but F(T(H1)) != F(T(H2))) -- with 258.31 stating this is decided empirically ('we do NOT ask philosophically'), and 258.15 already running the experiment (TraceOrigin distinguishes; pure audit metadata does not) -- so this half is blocked on the operation registry closing, not on taste. Which operations are mandatory (i.e. 𝒪/𝒯 ratification) and which of 258.31's three repair options to take (enrich K, supply as context, or remove the operation -- noting only the first two preserve the operation) are both classified NORMATIVE; everything else in the Decision-3 consequence table is classified MATHEMATICAL, following once the normative choices are fixed.
